tool.name: BIGSdb upload NRC
tool.description: Upload isolate pipeline results to corresponding DTAP BIGSdb instance
tool.command: $__tool_directory__/run_bigsdb_upload.sh ## positional argument 1: Tsv $section_input.tsv_file_path ## positional argument 2: user email $__user_email__ ## positional argument 3: logfile for Galaxy user $output_log
tool.help: This tool uploads galaxy reports to the dedicated NRC internal BIGSdb instance, it parses the species, sample_name and results from the output.It is currently only develop for neisseria. Only users with the required permissions can succesfully execute this tool. Only pipeline output-tsv's are allowed, no uploaded tsv's.
